title: Murmuru
requirements: A systematic and extensive multi-set character clothing capsule based on rich fantasy illustration themes. Deliverables included layered skirts, weapon back accessories, detailed hats, custom eyes texture mappings, front-type torso garments, sleeves, and organic bat wings with damaged edge-effects. All systems had to warp accurately around specific blocky body archetypes without breaking mesh bindings.
achievements: Executed a comprehensive wardrobe capsule covering multiple thematic updates
Engineered exact vertex weight paintings to match distinct blocky anatomy scales
Created custom visual accents and double-sided materials resolving face-culling errors
